questions.question: How much solar generation did the California ISO curtail in September 2026, in MWh?
questions.answer: CAISO curtailed 163,494.642 MWh of solar in September 2026 (iso_curtailment_monthly, derived, variable curtailed_solar_mwh, entity caiso:ISO). The same total, 163,494.642 MWh, comes from summing CAISO's own daily figures in caiso_curtailment_daily (source). That sum covers all 30 September days, using local Pacific operating days. The monthly table's coverage field lists 696 hours held out of 720 hours in the month (iso_curtailment_monthly). It also lists 720 held of 744 for October, so I read this as that table's own hours count. The daily table is complete for the month.

questions.question: Measured as its demand less its own generation (the balance), how much electricity did the California ISO import on net in August 2026, in MWh?
questions.answer: On the balance measure (demand less own net generation), the California ISO (EIA-930 balancing authority CISO) imported 4,981,715 MWh on net in August 2026. That is 19.66% of its demand of 25,338,610 MWh. All 31 days were held and none were left out (ba_supply_monthly, derived; variable net_import_balance_mwh, monthly total for the August 2026 local month). Caveat: this table's method note says CAISO's balance reads about 10 points higher than its flows since December 2025, because EIA's published net generation for CAISO dropped then. The sum of the neighbour-by-neighbour flows (net_import_pairs_mwh) is lower at 2,101,695 MWh, and the table treats that pair sum as its headline import figure.
